title: Implement business info editor component
description: Implement the BusinessInfoEditor component for the editor. Allows editing core business info (name, phone, email, address) with changes reflected in all sections that use these fields.
acceptanceCriteria: BusinessInfoEditor renders in the editor left panel
Changes update the prospect's business data in page_data
Sections that display business info (hero, contact, cta) reflect changes in the preview
Verify in browser with Playwright screenshot

steps.details: Client component. Props: `business: BusinessData, onChange: (field: string, value: string) => void`. Render as a collapsible section card with inputs for business_name, phone, email, location.
Each field `onChange` calls parent `onChange(field, value)`. Parent updates the `business` object in page_data. SectionRenderer uses this updated business data to re-render sections.
Take Playwright screenshot. Change the business name. Verify hero section in preview updates with new name.
